note: Curated MCP servers worth self-hosting behind the gate. Commands run ON YOUR MACHINE as you — review them (they print at startup). Edit <placeholders> before starting.

servers.name: Filesystem
servers.description: Read, write and search files in folders you choose. The canonical 'give my agent my notes/projects' server — the data never leaves your machine.

servers.name: Memory (knowledge graph)
servers.description: Persistent memory your agents share across chats, stored as a local knowledge graph file you own.

servers.name: Git
servers.description: Read, search and analyze a local git repository — history, diffs, blame — without pushing anything anywhere.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.description: Issues, PRs, and repos via your personal access token — the token stays on your box instead of being pasted into every agent.

servers.name: Playwright (browser)
servers.description: Drive a real browser on your machine — navigate, click, screenshot. Sessions and logins stay local.

servers.name: Fetch (web)
servers.description: Fetch and convert web pages for your agents, from your own IP — no third-party proxy seeing your browsing.

servers.name: SQLite
servers.description: Query and update a local SQLite database — analytics on your own data files without exporting them.

servers.name: Postgres
servers.description: Read-only SQL over a Postgres database you run — schema inspection and queries against the real thing.
